registryAssessment: The Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Revenue & Estate Department lists an SDC at Bannu Tehsil Building, Chai Bazar, Bannu City and describes computerized land-record services. Its official computerization page also lists Bannu among the districts and reports operational mauza coverage. This is Bannu-specific registry evidence, not evidence for other provinces.
